name: Magic Copy for Elementor
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Magic Copy for Elementor is a productivity plugin that lets you copy any Elementor element (Widget, Column, Section, or Container) from your site’s frontend and paste it directly into the Elementor editor on another website.

Whether you are a designer managing multiple client sites or a developer building a component library, Magic Copy streamlines your workflow with seamless cross-domain copying.

Key Features:

  • Frontend Copy: Copy elements directly from the live page.
  • Cross-Domain Support: Paste copied elements into any site with Elementor and Magic Copy installed.
  • Deep Copy: Includes all settings, styles, and content.
  • Child Elements: Option to include or exclude child elements (nested columns, widgets, etc.).
  • Media Handling: Automatically handles image and media imports.
  • Access Control: Configure who can see the copy button (Admins, Editors, Logged-in users, or Everyone).
  • Native Paste: Use standard paste shortcuts (Cmd+V / Ctrl+V) in the Elementor editor.
  • No Elementor Pro Required: Works with Elementor Free and is fully compatible with Elementor Pro.

How it Works:

  1. Enable “Magic Copy” in the Advanced tab of any Elementor element.
  2. View the page on the frontend.
  3. Hover over the element and click the “Copy” button.
  4. Go to the destination site’s Elementor editor.
  5. Press Ctrl+V (Windows) or Cmd+V (Mac) to paste.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/magic-copy-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Magic Copy > Settings to configure permissions.
  4. Open a page in Elementor to start enabling Magic Copy on your elements.
sections.faq:
Does this work across different domains?

Yes. You can copy an element from Site A and paste it into Site B, as long as both sites have Elementor and Magic Copy for Elementor installed.

Can I copy entire sections?

Yes, you can copy Widgets, Columns, Sections, and Containers. You can also choose whether to include their child elements.

Who can see the copy button?

You can control this in Magic Copy > Settings. Options include Administrators only, Editors, Logged-in users, or Everyone.

Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No. Magic Copy for Elementor works with Elementor Free and does not depend on Elementor Pro.

Is this plugin lightweight and performance-friendly?

Yes. It is a lightweight plugin with minimal frontend assets, designed to keep performance impact low.
